verification_result.notes: just --list passed and showed test, test-unit, and test-integration. test-unit reached cargo test --workspace --all-features but was terminated once with exit 137 and then exceeded the 240s command budget under CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 during workspace compilation. test-integration initially exposed a missing workspace member for agileplus-integration-tests, which was fixed by adding the crate to Cargo workspace members; after that, the command reached cargo and failed with os error 28 no space left on device while creating target/debug artifacts.
